verdicts.evidence: The hour labels sit centred over cells 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 and so on. The 10:00 column (cell 10) is orange on all five weekdays, and the 11:00 column is red on Mon and Fri and orange on Tue to Thu, while the side panel says 'Busiest hour, weekdays 10:00'.
The legend runs violet, blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, red for 0–4 up to 30+, with yellow the lightest step, and the large overnight areas are filled with saturated violet.
The title reads 'When new tickets arrive' and the subtitle only describes the data, so neither states a finding.
